description: Severe storm reports (tornado, wind, hail) — NOAA Storm Prediction Center preliminary local storm reports for a convective day (12Z to 12Z). date=today|yesterday|YYYY-MM-DD (2005 on); optional state=TN, type=tornado|wind|hail, lat=&lon=&radius_miles= (default 50) to find reports near a point, limit= (default 100). Returns activity level QUIET/MINOR/ACTIVE/SIGNIFICANT/MAJOR, counts by type and state, largest hail (inches), strongest wind gust (mph), and each report with UTC time, location, county, coordinates, NWS office and remarks. Useful for insurance claims, roofing leads and damage checks. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_storm_reports
